name: rova-app
description: Rova Workflow Builder — visual workflow automation with a node-based editor and plugin integrations

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names app,client,inngest --prefix-colors blue,green,magenta "pnpm run dev:app" "pnpm --filter @rova/client dev" "pnpm run dev:inngest"
scripts.dev:app: NODE_ENV=development HOST=127.0.0.1 INNGEST_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8388 tsx watch examples/app.ts
scripts.dev:inngest: sh -c 'if [ -x ./node_modules/.bin/inngest ]; then until curl -sSf http://localhost:${PORT:-4017}/api/inngest >/dev/null 2>/dev/null; do sleep 1; done; DO_NOT_TRACK=1 ./node_modules/.bin/inngest dev --no-discovery -u http://localhost:${PORT:-4017}/api/inngest -p 8388 --connect-gateway-port 8390 --connect-gateway-grpc-port 50062 --connect-executor-grpc-port 50063 --persist; else echo "[inngest] inngest-cli is not installed; skipping local Inngest dev server"; fi'
